mechanism.summary: Split the cold named-property reader into the existing entry and a hot-miss entry. Both share identical ordinary/exotic guards and own/prototype/general resolution, but the wide caller that just tried get_prop_named_hot skips repeating probe_hot inside the cold reader. Keep the original unchecked entry for other callers; no new hot executor state, no new prototype proof, no value/activation ABI change.
mechanism.generality: Any wide named-property read whose hot cache probe has just missed; the miss token is control flow, with no user code or mutation between the probes. Type/layout/key-independent admission; no corpus shape recognition. Estimated removable repeated-probe chunk 15-40 instructions / 3-10 cycles per cold read, not the entire 338.5-instruction or 38.8-cycle lookup gap. Tree reach is small, hence near-neutral target ceiling; every target pair must still improve.
semantic_risks: Hot miss may mean primitive or exotic receiver: retain full cold eligibility guards and general Get fallback
Accessor and Proxy hooks may change properties or prototypes; lookup order and receiver binding must remain identical
Own property shadows, different receiver identities and epoch changes must still take existing guarded resolution
Other callers must still perform their first hot probe; class-field initializer code is outside scope
Do not alter native loop readiness, exit bookkeeping, cells or exact resumption
